requirement: The dsh gate pages, the whitelist confirmation mail, the @tracy/ui controls and My Sites follow the interface language; the Vietnamese keep-verbatim rule is the one its gate enforces

oracle.ref: PR #840 (fix); fix evidence: Issue #797: a vi/de/it/fr/nl/es browser got the Chinese gate page; the confirmation mail and six @tracy/ui controls were hard-coded English; 128 vi strings translated a keep-verbatim term away while the gate stayed green; My Sites said 'seat book'.
oracle.invariant: S1: 0 failures, 0 skipped. 'a browser in any shipped language gets that language, never Chinese' passes: Accept-Language vi, de, it, fr, nl, es each resolve to themselves; nothing usable resolves to en. 'q=0, a malformed q and a wildcard are not choices' and 'precedence is unchanged: ?lang, then the cookie, then the dsh setting, then the browser' pass. 'the lane sign-in page follows the browser in every shipped language' passes: <html lang> is the language and no Han character is on a non-zh page. 'no site key: the lane page still does not exist, in any language' passes: 404, no form. 'a refusal keeps its status and speaks the reader’s language, with English for what is untranslated' passes: the 403 stays a 403. 'the door writes the mail in the language of the request' passes for all eight languages, and 'a retry in another language sends the payload stored first, unchanged' passes. 'refusals come before any side effect, whatever language is asked for' passes: no statement ran, no mail left. 'no control defaults a label to an English word' and the per-control render tests pass: each control shows the caller's words and none of the first render's words after a second render. 'a translation that keeps one term and loses another is a problem' passes, and 'the Vietnamese catalogue that ships keeps every term of its sources' finds no dropped term. 'restore.forbiddenBody names the two roles as every other language does' passes: Owner and Admin are in the vi sentence. 'the two reported lines no longer say "seat book" or "your seats"' passes. 'gateway: every shipped translation is the sentence of the catalogue it names' passes: each of the 198 gateway translations equals its listed source, whose English equals the gateway's English. S2: exit 0 (a label left out of a control is a type error; an unused @ts-expect-error would fail here). S3: all three gates pass, with known debt 0 in every language. S4: 0 failures, 0 skipped. At 320×568 and 375×667, on the sign-in page and the first-run setup page, in nl, vi and zh: the eight language links sit on two rows inside the card and the screen, none overlaps another or the content below, a tap on each lands on it, and the page does not scroll sideways. On a 320×320 screen the card is taller than the screen and both its ends scroll into view. 'the measurement sees the old layout: one clipped, absolutely positioned row' passes: the same measurement reports links outside the card and a single row when the former rules are put back. 'Traditional Chinese is never answered in Simplified: the next tag decides, or English' and 'the setting is read as YAML structure: only the top-level locale.preference counts' pass in S1.
